title: RFC/Suggestion to add a more native Zig API
body:
This PR is no where near complete; But wanted to open this PR to offer a suggestion and/or get feedback. I would rebase and create a stack of clean commits if there's any interest.

Context; I'm in the process of making a FFT waterfall toy thing, but I'm not a fan of the raw C api, so after upgrading it to work with zig master I started working on a more zig friendly API. It's currently far from complete, but I'd be happy to expand it to as much of the pipewire API as I'm able.

an example of it in use contrast 
before: https://srctree.gr.ht/repo/vizz/ref/2888db992d339b5455358a7ea8c26b4b9bda2253/blob/src/pipewire.zig#L54 
after https://srctree.gr.ht/repo/vizz/ref/5e34965905d485d4cc1ea73de7d4acfb3454e78c/blob/src/pipewire.zig#L33 The zig native API requires fewer lines, and includes error handling. 

I'd apprecate any comments, suggestions, or insults. Or please close this if a zig API is out of scope. 

Cheers

title: chore: add metadata.h
video-play: fix stream buffer API usage, requeue before dequeue
body:
Fixes "Invalid Param" errors when calling queue_buffer.

After playing around with the API, pipewire will sometimes return the same buffer when calling dequeue that was previously returned.  We would then call queue and now we have an invalidated buffer.

I didn't find anything in pipewire that says you can't dequeue multiple buffers at a time, so this might be a bug in pipewire.

title: Simplifies initialization of logger
body: It's convenient to make the logger a global since it needs to survive the lifetime of the program. However, unless we're targeting the x64 backend, extern references can't be resolved at comptime. This PR works around this by making the logger a singleton, and also adds an init helper to make it easier to use.

title: Fixes build for aarch64-linux-gnu
body:
Zig doesn't currently provide a varargs implementation for aarch64 Linux (see [this issue](https://github.com/ziglang/zig/issues/15389)). To get the build working on this target, I've moved all the vararg code to C.

This PR isn't yet ready to merge:
* I need to fix the build with use zig module set to false 
* I need to do a pass over it to clean it up

title: Consider replacing preprocessor wrapping with linker options
body:
Right now, we wrap symbols like `dlopen` via the preprocessor. We also do this to namespace symbols that would otherwise conflict.

This works, but if possible, it'd be nicer to do this with a linker arg like `--wrap`, or via a linker script, since this is a bit more direct (no chance of renaming anything unintended) and would likely allow us to avoid exposing implementation details like glibc's `open_2`.

I've opted not to do this for now since I don't want to introduce a dependency on a specific linker. Building with Zig's non-llvm x64 backend in debug mode is super useful, it's not worth breaking that workflow over this. IIRC there are plans for Zig to get its own linker script setup that would allow setting up linker scripts in a cross-linker way, once that happens this should be revisited.

(h/t [deivid](https://lobste.rs/c/oqm951))

title: Support additional conversions in audioconvert via sndfile
body:
Pipewire optionally uses sndfile for additional audio format conversions. Supporting this would involve first porting sndfile to the Zig build system.

This isn't high priority for me right now, contributions are welcome though! The steps at a very high level would be:
* Create a separate project porting sndfile to Zig's build system
* Define `HAVE_SNDFILE` when building audioconvert and add it as a dependency

(related to #7)

title: Reenable SSE41 in audioconvert
body: Blocked on [upstream patch](https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/pipewire/pipewire/-/merge_requests/2635). Search "sse41" in `build.zig` for the relevant commented out code.

title: remove build options from zin dependency
body: Since zin is just a zig module, we don't need to specify a target/optimize mode. This allows the same module to be imported into other compilation units even if they are different targets/optimize modes.

title: Compile time configuration of modules/plugins
body: Right now, we always include all the modules and plugins necessary for the `video-play` example. If we add more over time, we may want to add a compile time option for choosing which to enabled since none of the init functions will be considered dead code even if unused due to being referenced by the library table.

title: Translate C workarounds
body:
I cached `c.zig` in the repo so that I could manually work around some translate C issues. Most (all?) of them have been patched now.

Once we upgrade this library to a new stable release of Zig that includes the patches--or start using Translate C as an external package--we should remove the cached `c.zig` and just generate it as part of the build process.

title: zin
body: Ported the video-play example from SDL to [zin](https://github.com/marler8997/zin) so that it can be fully statically linked.

title: Logger
body:
Adds an (optional) logger that forwards logs to `std.log`. Normally I would keep this kind of stuff out of the build system ports, but in this case:
* You almost certainly want it if you're using Pipewire
* Figuring out how to set it up wasn't easy

title: Static build
body: This PR removes Pipewire's dependence on the dynamic linker through build config alone (no need to fork Pipewire.)
